blocks.content: Quiz: A Recharts chart renders with zero visible height on SpeedBlip's Dashboard. What is the most likely cause?
Tap an option below to answer:
The chart data array is empty so Recharts renders nothing
An empty data array renders the chart axes and container with zero height - it does not cause the entire chart to disappear silently. An empty chart still occupies its defined height.
An empty data array renders the chart axes and container with zero height - it does not cause the entire chart to disappear silently. An empty chart still occupies its defined height.
ResponsiveContainer is a direct child of a flex container with no explicit height on the wrapper div

Correct. When ResponsiveContainer has height="100%" but its parent is a flex container with no defined height, the 100% resolves to zero. The fix is wrapping it in a div with an explicit pixel height.

Correct. When ResponsiveContainer has height="100%" but its parent is a flex container with no defined height, the 100% resolves to zero. The fix is wrapping it in a div with an explicit pixel height.
The Recharts LineChart requires a minHeight prop to be visible in production builds
Recharts has no minHeight prop requirement. The issue is the parent container's height, not a chart-level configuration.
Recharts has no minHeight prop requirement. The issue is the parent container's height, not a chart-level configuration.
Vite's production build strips unused Recharts chart types to reduce bundle size
Vite tree-shakes unused code, but Recharts components imported and used in the component are retained. Bundle optimization is not the cause of invisible charts.
Vite tree-shakes unused code, but Recharts components imported and used in the component are retained. Bundle optimization is not the cause of invisible charts.
